description: The calibration ruler: two hundred content-diverse prompts whose only job is to wash content out of the average, so that what a positional mean retains is position. The prompts vary in form as well as topic — explanations, stories, letters, dialogue, advice, arguments, code, worked problems, plans and summaries — because a mean over one kind of request keeps that request's shape. The first fifty are the ruler the banked positional means and residual bases were fitted over, unchanged and in order, so a fit over the first fifty reproduces them. Every corrected feature subtracts a mean fitted over these prompts, so a change here changes every signature downstream without changing any argument. Pinned by digest in tests/test_prompt_sets.py.
